entities.summary: Volodymyr Hryhorovych Rutkivskyi was a Ukrainian novelist. His work primarily dealt with historical fiction and adventure in the form of children's literature. Rutkivskyi is best known as the writer of The Stronghold, which later had a film adaptation, and the tetralogy Jura («Джури»).
